name: gentle-space-web
install: npm install && (cd auth-service && npm install) && (cd ads-agent && npm install)

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Main marketing/listings site (gentle-space-web) on http://localhost:3000. DB/AI/Maps features need real credentials (add via Secrets); DB-backed pages degrade to an empty state without them.

terminals.name: auth-service
terminals.description: Admin auth service (SSO) on http://localhost:3040. Boots in dev without a database (its dev script unsets DATABASE_URL/Google OAuth vars).

terminals.name: ads-agent
terminals.description: Ads agent console on http://localhost:3030. Unauthenticated requests redirect to the auth-service login. Full features need Postgres/Pub-Sub/Google Ads credentials.
